# Discover Tamarins VR 🐒

The ultimate community-driven virtual reality experience designed for players who love **classic physics-based locomotion** and **fast-paced multiplayer fun**.

Inspired by the nostalgic golden era of **2023 VR movement games**, Tamarins VR lets you **swing, slide, and race** through vibrant jungle environments using only your hands.

## Step Into the World 🌴

Step into the **social lobby** to meet players from around the world, show off your unique style with a **massive selection of unlockable cosmetics**, and dive into a variety of exciting **minigames**.

Whether you are chasing friends in competitive modes or exploring hidden corners of the map, there is always something to do.

> **Grab your headset, master the movement, and join the community today!**
